block-core-cup-mps126.summary: A separate shallow metal cup closes a casting access opening in the block. This uninstalled MPS-126 replacement envelope shows the closed floor and open rim; it does not establish a particular bore or installation.
block-core-cup-mps126.limits: Five are listed in the applicable MPE-107R replacement kit, not a complete OEM plug inventory. Free OD and height are published; 1 mm uniform wall, square corners and all host interfaces remain unknown or estimated. No engine positions or press-fit deformation are modeled.

steps.title: Identify the separate closure
steps.text: The plug is a physical part distinct from the block casting. The cup floor closes the opening; the rim and outer wall would meet its host bore.

steps.title: Keep nominal size separate from free diameter
steps.text: Melling lists nominal 1.625 in, free OD 1.640–1.642 in and height 0.365 in. The candidate uses 41.656 mm free OD and 9.271 mm height; neither nominal size nor free OD specifies the host bore.

steps.title: Resolve the installed interface
steps.text: A measured bore axis, diameter, seating depth and applicable installation specification are needed before placement. Wall thickness, stamping radii and interference also remain unresolved.

troubleshooting.title: A nearby leak does not identify the plug
troubleshooting.text: Trace the fluid path and inspect the actual closure and surrounding casting. This model has no pressure or leakage simulation and cannot diagnose a failed seal.

troubleshooting.title: Do not infer a bore from the kit
troubleshooting.text: The replacement kit count identifies candidate parts to reconcile, not their engine locations. A cup can have the correct free envelope while being assigned to the wrong opening.
